prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: TALKPIK AI auth pass-through landing dashboard concept
Input image role: source screenshot is a reference for current-account-redirect dashboard state only.
Primary request: Redesign 40-X-18-auth-consent/current-account-redirect.
Direction: silent consent gate pass-through.
Composition/framing: desktop 1280x900 edge-to-edge app UI screenshot only; no browser address bar, tabs, bookmarks bar, OS window title bar, device frame, or watermark. Show a normal authenticated TALKPIK dashboard after consent check: sidebar, compact KPI row, today's recommended writing task, continue writing card, feedback pending panel, recent feedback list, quick links, and notification area. No modal, no consent form, no legal checklist.
Style/medium: high-fidelity Ant Design workspace dashboard, restrained 4-8px radii, flat neutral cards, compact scan-friendly density.
Color palette: Mist/Snow/Fog/Obsidian; Obsidian only for the primary continue/start study CTA; secondary actions outline or text.
Typography: Cosmica-like single sans typography, compact and readable, no letter spacing.
Constraints: current-account-redirect must read as successful pass-through into dashboard; do not expose provider tokens or auth internals; Korean UI text is visual direction only and not final copy source.
Avoid: browser chrome, OS frame, device frame, consent checklist, OAuth details, legal panic banner, AI gradients, chromatic CTA repetition, bubble card radius, watermark.
